article.title: Spain’s top court grants release of pro-Palestine activist Fergie Chambers after U.S. admits altering key evidence
article.author: Editor
article.content: Hours before his release, Irish media revealed that Chambers's Dublin home was raided by police at Washington's request. The post Spain’s top court grants release of pro-Palestine activist Fergie Chambers after U.S. admits altering key evidence appeared first on MR Online .
